from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(50-mu)/40; sf=norm.sf(a); return mu+40*norm.pdf(a)/sf-110 if sf>1e-10 else 1e10
mu=brentq(eq,-200,109)
assert abs(mu-102.57)<1.5
assert abs(norm.sf((50-mu)/40)-0.9056)<0.01
